name: A Crossed Path
source:
Play as Ellen (a.k.a Dallan) Arlace (renamable) who transferred to Valant Academy just because the opportunity presented itself to her. As much as she wants to lay low, she finds herself tangled in other people's problems yet again. Though... maybe this time it has a happy ending.

[From [url=https://kiiihiru.itch.io/a-crossed-path]itch.io[/url]]
